name: BOSS / SDSS-III
summary: SDSS-III spectroscopic survey measuring cosmic structure through galaxy distributions and the quasar Lyman-alpha forest; its data can constrain decaying or warm dark matter.
detection_principle: Multi-object spectroscopy measures redshifts and reconstructs three-dimensional clustering and absorption power spectra for comparison with dark-matter structure-growth predictions.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: This entry covers only the 2009–2014 SDSS-III BOSS project, not the entire continuing SDSS program.

results.summary: BOSS-DR12 combined with other data constrains specific dark-matter decay models.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
